subject.title: Draft: add commands list and inspect inventory

question: Should OpenClaw adopt separate operator/developer `openclaw commands` inventory schemas and the new advisory plugin CLI metadata alongside Gateway `commands.list`?
rationale: The latest implementation is technically credible, but the linked RFC remains open and tests cannot decide the permanent public schema, ownership, and plugin compatibility contract.

options.title: Approve the narrow audience split
options.body: Accept separate CLI and Gateway inventories for distinct audiences and own the documented plugin metadata as supported advisory API.

options.title: Require a shared canonical projection
options.body: Refactor overlapping command semantics into one shared model before publishing the CLI schemas.

options.title: Pause pending RFC approval
options.body: Keep the draft open but defer merge preparation until maintainers settle the permanent inventory architecture.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow audience split
recommendation.body: Accept separate CLI and Gateway inventories for distinct audiences and own the documented plugin metadata as supported advisory API.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history covers all central surfaces and the live discussion explicitly routes the public contract decision to this person.
